description: This Java source file defines a class responsible for mapping policy modify command response signals to their corresponding JSON representations within a protocol adapter. It implements specific strategies for different response types related to policy modifications, resource management, and subjects.

classes.name: PolicyModifyCommandResponseMappingStrategies
classes.description: A singleton class that provides strategies for mapping policy modify command response signals to their JSON representations, handling different types of responses and responses related to policy, resource, and subject modifications.

methods.name: initMappingStrategies
methods.description: Initializes and returns a map associating response type strings with their corresponding JSON mapping strategies.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the mapping strategies.

methods.name: addTopLevelResponses
methods.description: Adds mappings for top-level policy responses such as create, modify, and delete responses.

methods.name: addPolicyEntryResponses
methods.description: Adds mappings for policy entry-related responses such as modification and deletion.

methods.name: addPolicyEntryResourceResponses
methods.description: Adds mappings for responses related to policy entry resources, including creation, modification, and deletion.

methods.name: addPolicyEntrySubjectResponses
methods.description: Adds mappings for responses concerning policy subjects, including creation, modification, and deletion.

methods.name: policyCreated
methods.description: Creates a 'created' response for a policy modification.

methods.name: policyModified
methods.description: Creates a 'modified' response for a policy.

methods.name: entryCreated
methods.description: Creates a 'created' response for a policy entry.

methods.name: entryModified
methods.description: Creates a 'modified' response for a policy entry.

methods.name: resourceCreated
methods.description: Creates a 'created' response for a resource modification.

methods.name: resourceModified
methods.description: Creates a 'modified' response for a resource.

methods.name: subjectCreated
methods.description: Creates a 'created' response for a subject.

methods.name: subjectModified
methods.description: Creates a 'modified' response for a subject.
